name: file-upload
description: Multipart file upload endpoint that stores each user's files via object storage and presigns them only for the uploader or an administrator.
instructions: Configure the selected object-storage provider before uploading files.
Uploads are stored as uploads/<userId>/<uuid>-<name>. Add the auth module so every upload has an owner.
Upload a file:  curl -b cookies.txt -F 'file=@./some.png' localhost:5002/files
The response includes { key, url } — an S3 presigned URL or a signed local download URL.
Presign it again (owner or administrator, key URL-encoded):  curl -b cookies.txt localhost:5002/files/uploads%2F<userId>%2F<file>/url
Uploads stored before per-user keys (uploads/<file>) can only be presigned by administrators.
